summary: All four registered runs completed with exit 0 and no infrastructure retries; for all 125 seeds one worker and two workers give the same outcome and the same trajectory_sha256. --workers changes the wall time, not the results.
machine: home PC, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB (driver 610.88), Ryzen 9 5900XT, 64 GB RAM; Isaac Sim 6.2 + Isaac Lab 3.0, cuda:0; all runs at c43e63a (code identical to 71668b3)

replay_S.note: A so101-gate run (41682125551, triggered by pushing this branch) held the runner from 12:13:41 to 12:40:41: about 90% of this run was contended, so its time and GPU memory are not used. Outcomes and hashes are unaffected (below).

dev_S.result: 46/50, 0 retries, 1373 s (27.5 s/seed), no runner job

replay_P.precondition: 13:43:38: 10210 MB free GPU memory (median of 30 s), no runner job, 21.2 GB host RAM free
replay_P.result: 6/75, 0 retries, 934 s (12.4 s/seed), no runner job; host RAM free never below 12.6 GiB

dev_P.precondition: 14:00:23: 10176 MB free GPU memory, no runner job, 17.6 GB host RAM free
dev_P.result: 46/50, 0 retries, 819 s (16.4 s/seed), no runner job; host RAM free never below 9.96 GiB

criteria.workers recorded: met: S runs record 1, P runs record 2

predictions.P at most 0.6 of S's time per seed: held on dev (16.4 / 27.5 = 0.60, speedup 1.68x); not assessed on replay, whose S run was contended (12.4 vs 24.1 s/seed)

measured.vram_constant_mb: max(3379, 5374 / 2) = 3379, +25% = 4224, rounded up to 256: 4352 per worker; two workers need 8704 MB free
measured.kit_logs: every worker process wrote its own Kit log: 75 distinct names in replay_P, 50 in dev_P
measured.per_process_seconds: 27.4 s with one worker, 32.1 s with two (dev): each process is slower, the pair is 1.68x faster

deviations.what: First replay_P attempt ran with two drivers at once (up to 4 Isaac processes), not as registered.
deviations.cause: Operator error: stopping a background launcher with Claude Code's TaskStop left its child loops alive under Git Bash; the old launcher passed its own free-memory check at 13:14:22 and started replay_P next to the replacement launcher's (13:15:25). See docs/knowledge/testing.md.
deviations.result_kept: The driver that finished: 6/75, 0 flips and 75/75 identical trajectory_sha256 against replay_S, so 4 concurrent processes did not move results either; but 3 infrastructure retries, at the budget limit: seed 5 timed out (423 s), seed 19 hit a MemoryError in warp's codegen, seed 20 failed with 'PxgAABBManager: failed to allocate pinned host buffers'. All three are host-memory pressure. Its times and GPU memory are not usable (two samplers wrote the same file).
deviations.decision: piperobot-e5 approved one binding rerun of replay_P with one launcher that refuses to start while an evaluator driver is alive; the rerun above is it.

deviations.what: A dev_P started by the orphaned launcher at 13:41:38 was killed about a minute later.
deviations.result_kept: None: no results; discarded by e5's decision.

deviations.what: The P precondition used >= 7.5 GB free instead of the registered 6.5 GB.
deviations.cause: Stricter than registered: the measured 1-worker peak (3379 MB) made 2 x peak = 6.76 GB, above 6.5 GB.
deviations.result_kept: Both P runs started with about 10.2 GB free.

consequences: --workers 2 is safe for the gate's results; workers stays outside the platform guard (ADR 0036).
More than two concurrent Isaac processes ran out of host memory on this machine (deviation run): the gate uses at most 2.
